payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort coordinate arrays to get extreme values and second extremes, then find a point in at least n-1 rectangles by excluding each rectangle.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts minx, maxx, miny, maxy arrays to easily obtain the overall max of minx and second max, etc., which are used to compute intersection of n-1 intervals. Sorting is the main tool, and though no custom comparator is defined, it aligns closest with 'sorting_custom_key' among the candidate subtypes.
